verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs explicitly state that transformations (including dbt) are 'automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule,' and separate docs describe Fivetran-hosted dbt Core integration and dbt Cloud orchestration for centralizing transformations tied to sync completion. This directly supports event-driven (not blind-timer) dbt runs triggered by fresh data loads.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the post-sync trigger works reliably in practice, and more detail on dbt Cloud job-trigger mechanics beyond the docs summary.
